name: switch__apple_write_success
description: Apple writes OnOff=true on a real cluster server (single_onoff_endpoint_source topology). The bridge dispatches the write through MatterWrite, the fake source flips its boolean and bumps DataVersion, and the bridge replies with a WriteResponse on the same exchange. A subsequent CCU-side notifier fire then ships a ReportData carrying a DataVersion strictly greater than the pre-write value — locks the contract that 'Apple-driven writes advance the cluster's DataVersion the same way CCU-driven echoes do' (Matter §10.6.5).
